name: StyleNeRF
definition: A 3D-aware generative model that merges 3D scene representation with style-based generative models.
summary: StyleNeRF is a 3D-aware generative model that achieves high-resolution, multi-view consistent synthesis by performing volume rendering at low resolution and upsampling in 2D space, while explicitly conditioning NeRF weights on style vectors for fine-grained appearance control.
